fields.Name: IT107 - Content Pipeline Lifecycle
fields.Description: Runs the content pipeline framework's record lifecycle end to end against real rows: discover -> extract -> segment -> embed -> re-extract with fewer segments -> delete. Only the source (a registered in-memory Discover driver), the vector store (a registered RecordingVectorDB reached through a real MJ: Vector Databases row) and the embedding call stand in; the processor, hydrator, committer, child reconciliation, stages and vector router are the shipped code. CP1 discover creates items and clears ForceDiscovery; CP2 extract + segment produce chunks; CP3 embed writes each chunk's vector under its own id in its source's namespace and records the receipt; CP4 an unchanged re-walk is a no-op; CP5 a changed document re-extracts, saves its new checksum, and re-segmenting supersedes every old chunk; CP6 Delete removes the superseded vectors in the namespace they were written to and purges the unreferenced rows; CP7 a metadata-only refresh updates in place and sends no values; CP8 deleting an item removes its vectors through its chunks.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Vectors are written, re-written and removed in the namespace their record routes to, re-segmentation leaves nothing searchable behind, and metadata refreshes never overwrite a stored vector.
